description: This file defines the OpenIdServerService class which manages OpenID Connect server settings, certificate handling, and security keys within the OrchardCore framework.

classes.name: OpenIdServerService
classes.description: Service class for managing OpenID Connect server settings, certificates, and security keys within OrchardCore.

methods.name: GetSettingsAsync
methods.description: Retrieves current OpenID server settings asynchronously.

methods.name: LoadSettingsAsync
methods.description: Loads the latest OpenID server settings asynchronously.

methods.name: GetSettingsFromContainer
methods.description: Extracts OpenID server settings from the site container, providing defaults if not set.

methods.name: UpdateSettingsAsync
methods.description: Updates the OpenID server settings asynchronously.

methods.name: ValidateSettingsAsync
methods.description: Validates the provided OpenID server settings asynchronously, returning validation results.

methods.name: GetAvailableCertificatesAsync
methods.description: Retrieves available X.509 certificates from system stores asynchronously.

methods.name: GetEncryptionKeysAsync
methods.description: Retrieves or generates encryption security keys asynchronously.

methods.name: GetSigningKeysAsync
methods.description: Retrieves or generates signing security keys asynchronously.

methods.name: PruneManagedCertificatesAsync
methods.description: Deletes expired managed certificates older than 7 days asynchronously.

methods.name: GetCertificate
methods.description: Finds a certificate by thumbprint in specified store location and name.

methods.name: GetEncryptionCertificateDirectory
methods.description: Gets directory info for encryption certificates based on shell options and settings.

methods.name: GetSigningCertificateDirectory
methods.description: Gets directory info for signing certificates based on shell options and settings.

methods.name: GetCertificatesAsync
methods.description: Retrieves valid certificates from a specified directory asynchronously.

methods.name: GetPasswordAsync
methods.description: Reads and unprotects the certificate password from a file asynchronously.

methods.name: GetCertificateAsync
methods.description: Loads a certificate from a file with password handling, supporting different key storage flags.

methods.name: GenerateEncryptionCertificate
methods.description: Creates a self-signed encryption certificate.

methods.name: GenerateSigningCertificate
methods.description: Creates a self-signed signing certificate.

methods.name: GenerateCertificate
methods.description: Generates a self-signed X.509 certificate with specified key usage.

methods.name: GenerateRsaSecurityKey
methods.description: Creates an RSA security key, using CNG APIs on Windows for better security.

methods.name: PersistCertificateAsync
methods.description: Saves a certificate and its password securely to disk asynchronously.
